description: This file defines the StackWidgetProvider class, which is an AppWidgetProvider for an Android home screen widget that displays a stack of items. It manages widget lifecycle events, handles updates, and processes user interactions such as item touch events to show Toast messages.

classes.name: StackWidgetProvider
classes.description: An Android AppWidgetProvider that manages a stack widget, handling updates, user interaction, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Handles the event when the widget is deleted.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Handles the event when the widget is disabled.

methods.name: onEnabled
methods.description: Handles the event when the widget is enabled.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Receives broadcasts and handles the TOAST_ACTION to show a Toast message indicating which item was touched.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Updates each widget by setting up the RemoteViews with a remote adapter service, empty view, and pending intent template for item clicks.
